purpose: Check that plans become lightweight implementation specs without PRD bloat.
positivePrompts: Turn this conversation into a lightweight spec.
Write a to-spec artifact for this agreed product direction.
negativePrompts: Review this diff for operational risk.

cases.prompt: A prototype proved the state machine; now create a production spec.
checks: Includes problem, goals, non-goals, constraints, UX/API contract, rollout, validation, and open questions.
Pressure-tests fuzzy terms, edge cases, contradictions, and assumptions before freezing the spec.
Uses existing repo vocabulary or ADRs when local context provides them.
Names the highest useful testing seams for external behavior.
Includes only decision-rich prototype output, not throw-away demo code.

traceExpectations: Spec synthesizes existing context before asking new questions.
Pressure-testing stays bounded to scope-changing questions or assumptions.
Repo/context reading precedes spec decisions when local code matters.
Validation names behavior seams rather than implementation details.
Open questions are limited to scope-changing unknowns.
